decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northwest and southeast walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 35 Park Close Hounslow

Condition : 6 - Before the development commences, details of an extended vehicular crossover of 3.6m width, off-street parking layout for two vehicles and details of front boundary treatment shall be submitted and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
description: Demolition of existing garage and the erection of a two storey side, single rear and roof extension to dwellinghouse.
